name: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
storyline:
Your journey begins as a licensed pharmacist in the modern world, where you manage your own pharmacy, serve customers, and build your pharmaceutical business from the ground up.

As your business grows, expand into factories, manufacture medications, purchase properties, and explore new opportunities. But your journey doesn't end in the present day.

Travel across four different eras, from medieval 1419 to a post-apocalyptic world in 2049 and a futuristic city in 2079. Each era brings unique environments, medications, businesses, and opportunities as you work toward building a pharmaceutical empire across time.
summary:
Formula Z: Controlled Dose is a first-person open-world pharmacy simulation game where you start as a pharmacist, manage your own pharmacy, serve customers, and grow your pharmaceutical business.

Expand into factories, manufacture medications, purchase properties, and explore a large open world filled with activities, vehicles, and business opportunities.

Travel between four different eras: the modern world, medieval 1419, post-apocalyptic 2049, and futuristic 2079. Each era features unique environments, pharmacies, factories, medications, and opportunities.
